profile_text.body:
Ouster, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, and trades under the ticker OUST. On its website the company describes itself as a maker of digital lidar sensors, which it says are used for autonomy in vehicles, robotics, and smart cities, as well as in automation and drones.

The site also cites a partnership with Komatsu. Matt Reiland, Technical Director, Automation Innovation at Komatsu, is quoted saying that Ouster's products developed through the partnership can withstand the shock, vibration and temperature constraints while delivering the enhanced range and spatial awareness necessary to operate in harsh mining environments.

Company records list Ouster as a for-profit public company with SEC CIK number 0001816581. No lawsuits and no MCP servers are recorded for it, and no individual products are tracked. Its recorded legal exposure is in California.
